title: Is supposed to hold a lot of shoes but...
text:
Is supposed to hold a lot of shoes but.... I will never know how many shoes this holds because I couldn't even get it put together. The parts didn't click together like they were supposed to. It was just a mess and I threw it in the trash.

I left feedback prior to this, but made a mistake. That feedback was for another shoe rack.
